tool_args.rationale: The highest observed s_grad is 2.44, below the proposed onset range of 2.50–2.68. The high-gradient probe is the cheapest targeted way to test whether the pilot trend continues smoothly or develops an additional sink above the threshold.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the avalanche threshold law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five rows are below the proposed threshold range, so the threshold and siphon strength have no effect on the observed values and cannot be fitted.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a Haldane or Cobb–Douglas law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot co-varies u_now and s_grad, so its flattening does not distinguish substrate inhibition or smooth scaling from a gradient-triggered drop outside the sampled range.
It costs more and is less directly targeted at crossing the proposed gradient threshold.
